notes: Multi-town zoning layer from NRPC Open Data (Nashua Regional Planning Commission), covering 13 Hillsborough County towns: Amherst, Brookline, Hollis, Hudson, Litchfield, Lyndeborough, Mason, Merrimack, Milford, Mont Vernon, Nashua, Pelham, Wilton. Other Hillsborough towns (e.g. Manchester, Goffstown, Bedford) are not included; NH counties do not zone. Updated weekly.
